## History

Hammond lived up the river and worked at a small sawmill situated in a clearing among stumps. He took [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) into his home, where she lived with his family for over two years. Hammond later died, leaving his wife to disperse the family.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)_
